formula: 2024 on-campus motor vehicle theft reports / fall 2024 total enrollment * 1000
scope: The existing site's selected 42 institutions, not all U.S. institutions.
cautions: The rate measures reported offenses relative to enrollment, not the probability that a student or their vehicle is victimized.
Numerators may include employees, visitors, repeated events and multiple reporting campuses; enrollment does not measure vehicles parked or time exposed.
Residential counts are a subset of on-campus counts; never add them to the campus total.
The all-geography comparison has fewer available institutions and cannot silently replace the on-campus comparison.
UCSF has zero undergraduate enrollment; excluding it must be explicit and not described as all UCs.
Three current institutional-source on-campus counts are unavailable; frozen federal values are not substituted.
The 2024 provisional fall enrollment file is the original denominator release used by this study; this audit confirms raw-file equality, not a fresh national NCES release search.
